storyBlocks.text: Not an afternoon where you only listen.
But a personal experience that makes you think, moves you, and helps you look at yourself and your life from a new perspective.
Happy People seminars bring together:
Not a standard presentation or distant theoretical talk, but relatable situations, honest experiences, and conversations that can reach you directly.
I share not only what I have learned, but also my own journey:

items: insights that only became clear later

storyBlocks.text: You don't have to believe anything in advance.
You don't have to change yourself.
You only need to be curious about what this afternoon can offer you.

A live seminar gives you something you cannot get from a standalone video or a book: a defined moment in which you consciously pause, actively participate, and connect new insights directly to your own life.
WHAT CAN YOU EXPECT?
During a seminar:

items: you reflect on your own situation
you get space to ask questions
you meet people who are also curious about personal growth

storyBlocks.text: Sometimes we laugh.
Sometimes it goes quiet.
Sometimes you discover a different way of looking at something you have been carrying for a while.
The value lies not only in what you hear during the seminar, but especially in what you can see, feel, or do differently afterwards.

You don't go home with only loose ideas. You receive questions, insights, and practical starting points to move forward with. Maybe something shifts that same day. Maybe a conversation keeps working on you for weeks.
IDENTITY
Who are you when you let go of other people's expectations for a moment?
We explore which roles, obligations, and images guide you.
You pause with questions such as:

items: What do I find important myself?
Which choices do I make for myself and which for others?
What image of myself am I still maintaining?
What would I do if I were less afraid of disappointing people?

storyBlocks.text: That can be confronting.
But it can also be liberating.
It starts with looking honestly. Only when you see what is truly guiding you does space open up to make conscious different choices.
CONNECTION
Why do we sometimes understand each other effortlessly, and lose each other at other moments?
We look at how we make contact, listen, and respond.
We also explore how assumptions, expectations, and old patterns sometimes keep us at a distance.
You gain relatable insights about:

items: why some people touch you deeply
how to reconnect without losing yourself

storyBlocks.text: The insights are not only meant for relationships with others. They also help you better understand how you treat yourself.
AFFIRMATIONS AND MANIFESTATION
We do not view affirmations and manifestation as a trick to order reality.
We explore what happens when thoughts, words, and behaviour move in the same direction.
Central questions include:

items: Where do I give my attention?
Which concrete steps can I take myself?

storyBlocks.text: Manifestation becomes practical and personal in this way.
Not as a replacement for action, but as an invitation to choose more consciously and take responsibility for your direction.

You discover not only what you would like, but also which beliefs and habits you reinforce daily. That makes it possible to stop only hoping for change and instead make a first concrete move yourself.
SPACE FOR YOUR QUESTIONS
Come listen, ask your question, and discover what the conversation can bring you.
You don't have to formulate your question perfectly.
An honest question can be the beginning of an insight that stays with you for a long time.
Precisely the questions you might normally swallow can be valuable. For yourself, but often also for others in the room who are dealing with something similar.
💬 YOUR QUESTION IS WELCOME
Within Happy People, you don't have to wait until Henk is online when something is on your mind or you're curious about something.
That is why we are building a personal AI assistant, trained on:

items: the knowledge I share within Happy People

The seminar doesn't stop when the afternoon is over.
Members can expect new stories, videos, and blogs: moments to pause, reflect, and choose direction again.

Because some things don't need to be explained — they can simply be felt.
Happy People is not a ready-made programme where everything is already fixed.
It grows with the people who take part.

We look again at:

items: how we relate to each other
what becomes possible when thoughts, words, and actions come back together

eventBlocks.text: Not from complicated theory, but from relatable situations, personal stories, and conversations that can stay with you long after the event.
WHY THIS AFTERNOON?
Because sometimes you don't need more information.
But you do need a moment to look honestly at the direction you're moving in.
Because you can know what you want and still feel stuck.
And because a live encounter does something different than watching a video alone.
You are present, you meet others, and you get space to:
This afternoon is valuable when you feel you're at a crossroads, when you keep ending up in the same patterns, or when you want to reconnect with what matters to you.
You don't need to come with a fully worked-out plan. You only need to be willing to look honestly and participate actively.
WHAT CAN YOU EXPERIENCE?
During this afternoon, there is space to:

items: connect with something greater than yourself
pause with dreams you may have lost
explore which beliefs hold you back
discover which first step you can take today
meet others who are curious about personal growth and genuine connection

eventBlocks.text: Maybe some dreams haven't disappeared because they're impossible.
Maybe we've forgotten we ever had them.
You won't be promised that everything will change on its own.
But you will get the chance to see more clearly:

items: which move you can make yourself

eventBlocks.text: Don't just dream.
Set your dreams in motion.
During the afternoon, we provide snacks and drinks.
That also creates space to meet each other and exchange experiences. Those conversations between sessions can become an important part of the experience.
LIMITED PLACES
The number of places is deliberately limited.
That is not a formality, but a choice. A smaller group creates more room for:
When the room is full, no extra places can be added without losing the quality and personal atmosphere of the afternoon.
That's why it's wise not to wait until just before the date. Those who reserve now secure their place and know for certain they can experience this live event.
TICKET
The seminar can only be reserved online.
Members get access to the recording.
Even if you can't be there live, you can experience the journey later.

Being there live remains the most complete experience. You share the stories, conversations, and energy with the other participants. You can respond directly, ask your question the moment it arises, and be part of the encounter instead of only watching afterwards.
The recording is a valuable addition, but cannot fully replace the live experience.
WHY RESERVE NOW?
Because waiting rarely brings more clarity.
You don't first need to know exactly what you're looking for. You don't need to wait until your calendar clears on its own or until you already have all the answers.
A reservation is a concrete choice to make time for yourself, for reflection, and for a new direction.
In addition, places are limited. Once the maximum is reached, reservations close.
So don't wait until you're certain you need this afternoon.
Curiosity is enough to begin.
Reserve your ticket now and give yourself an afternoon that can be not only inspiring, but also make a practical difference in how you see, choose, and act.
Maybe your journey begins here.
